ps.en: When a severe drought threatened to [[pose]] challenges to agricultural communities, a young artist took a [[position]] in the local council to promote [[positive]] change. Although she did not [[possess]] great wealth, her temporary [[possession]] of a community center allowed her to host workshops.
ps.zh: 当一场严重的旱灾给农业社区带来挑战时，一位年轻的艺术家在当地委员会中担任职务以促进积极的变革。虽然她没有拥有巨额财富，但她临时占有一座社区中心让她得以举办工作坊。

ps.en: To show how to [[dilute]] harmful pesticides, she painted a [[dim]] portrait of polluted rivers to warn against ecological [[diminishment|diminish]]. At first, critics dismissed her as a mere [[amateur]], but her ability to [[amaze]] spectators soon dispelled any [[ambiguous]] doubts about her purpose.
ps.zh: 为了展示如何稀释有害杀虫剂，她画了一副暗淡的污染河流肖像，以警告生态削减。起初，评论家驳斥她只是个单纯的业余爱好者，但她令观众惊叹的能力很快驱散了对其意图的任何模糊疑虑。

ps.en: Her ultimate [[ambition]] was to foster an [[ambitious]] youth movement dedicated to environmental stewardship across the region.
ps.zh: 她的终极野心是培养一场雄心勃勃的青年运动，致力于全地区的环境管理。

ps.en: Investors feared that the tech speculation [[bubble]] would burst before the company could finalize its annual [[budget]]. To [[build]] a sustainable enterprise, executives reorganized their core [[business]] model.
ps.zh: 投资者担心科技投机泡沫会在公司敲定年度预算前破裂。为了建立可持续的企业，高管们重组了他们的核心商业模式。

ps.en: Engineers attempted to [[compress]] data processing times, agreeing that the new platform would [[comprise]] advanced cloud services. Rather than make a risky [[compromise]] on security, they chose to [[conceive]] an innovative architecture and [[concentrate]] resources on algorithm optimization.
ps.zh: 工程师们试图压缩数据处理时间，同意新平台将包含先进的云服务。他们没有在安全方面做出危险的妥协，而是选择构想一种创新架构，并将资源集中在算法优化上。

ps.en: The underlying [[concept]] was to transform the original [[conception]] into a practical product. Driven by deep [[concern]] for user privacy, the team drafted a [[concise]] proposal with [[concrete]] steps, which they decided to [[conclude]] with a firm [[conclusion]] during a [[concurrent]] executive summit. They agreed to [[confer]] honorable awards at the annual [[conference]].
ps.zh: 其底层概念是将原始构想转化为实用产品。在对用户隐私深度关切的驱动下，团队起草了一份包含具体步骤的简明提案，他们决定在并发举行的高管峰会上做出明确结论。他们同意在年度会议上授予荣誉奖项。

ps.en: Historians will [[confess]] that recording an [[epic]] struggle during a global [[epidemic]] requires immense objectivity. Each historical [[episode]] marks a turning point in a grand [[epoch]].
ps.zh: 历史学家会坦白，在全局疫情期间记录一场史诗般的挣扎需要极大的客观性。每一个历史片段都标志着伟大时代中的转折点。

ps.en: Scholars warned against remaining [[indifferent]] to social inequality. An [[indignant]] public voiced its [[indignation]], demanding access to [[indispensable]] public resources for every [[individual]].
ps.zh: 学者们警告不要对社会不平等保持漠不关心。义愤填膺的公众表达了他们的愤慨，要求为每一个个人提供不可或缺的公共资源。

ps.en: To clear up the bureaucratic [[mess]], the director sent an urgent [[message]] via a trusted [[messenger]]. Reevaluating their research [[method]], [[militant]] activists and [[military]] advisors agreed in [[mind]] that reforms must [[redeem]] past errors, [[reduce]] unnecessary costs, ensure a swift [[reduction]] in pollution, and [[refer]] to historical precedent for reliable [[reference]].
ps.zh: 为了清理官僚混乱，主管通过信任的邮递员发送了紧急信息。重新评估他们的研究方法，激进的倡导者与军事顾问在思想上达成一致，认为改革必须赎回过去的错误、减少不必要的开支、确保迅速减少污染，并参考历史先例作为可靠依据。

c: pose a threat 构成威胁
pose a question 提出问题
words.dif: pose 侧重指造成困难、提出问题或摆出特定姿势；present 指呈现。
words.pat: Rapid urbanization can pose significant challenges to municipal infrastructure.
words.patZh: 快速城市化可能会对市政基础设施造成重大挑战。

c: take a position 担任职务/采取立场
in a position to 处于能够…的地位
words.dif: position 既可指具体物理位置，也可指工作职位或观点立场。
words.pat: She accepted a senior research position at the university.
words.patZh: 她接受了大学里的高级研究职位。

words.dif: positive 强调有建设性、乐观或呈阳性反应。
words.pat: Regular exercise produces positive effects on overall mental health.
words.patZh: 规律运动对整体心理健康产生积极的影响。

words.dif: possess 侧重具备某种品质、技能或依法拥有资产。
words.pat: Candidates must possess strong analytical skills and leadership experience.
words.patZh: 候选人必须具备强大的分析技能和领导经验。

c: in possession of 占有/拥有
words.dif: possession 复数形式特指个人私有物品财产。
words.pat: The historic documents came into the possession of the national archive.
words.patZh: 这些历史文件落入了国家档案馆的占有之中。

c: dilute a solution 稀释溶液
dilute the impact 冲淡影响
words.dif: dilute 液体加水稀释，或抽象减弱某种力量效应。
words.pat: Adding too much water will dilute the chemical strength of the mixture.
words.patZh: 加入太多的水会稀释该混合物的化学强度。

c: dim view of 认为…不大可能
words.dif: dim 指光线微弱暗淡或前景不明朗。
words.pat: The streetlights cast a dim glow through the heavy evening fog.
words.patZh: 街灯在沉重的晚雾中投射出暗淡的光晕。

c: diminish over time 随着时间减少
words.dif: diminish 指数量、重要性或权威逐渐减少变小。
words.pat: Nothing can diminish the profound impact of his groundbreaking discovery.
words.patZh: 没有什么能削减他突破性发现的深远影响。

c: amateur sports 业余体育运动
words.dif: amateur 指非出于职业赚钱目的而出于兴趣从事某事的人。
words.pat: The tournament welcomed both professional athletes and talented amateurs.
words.patZh: 该锦标赛欢迎职业运动员与有天赋的业余爱好者参加。

c: amaze the audience 使观众惊叹
be amazed at 对…感到惊奇
words.dif: amaze 强调因出乎意料的高超表现而令人极度惊叹。
words.pat: Her remarkable recovery continues to amaze doctors across the medical community.
words.patZh: 她显著的康复继续使整个医疗界的医生感到惊叹。

c: ambiguous statement 模棱两可的声明
words.dif: ambiguous 指由于表达不明确而可作多种不同解释。
words.pat: The contract contained ambiguous language that led to a protracted dispute.
words.patZh: 该合同包含模棱两可的措辞，导致了长期的争议。

words.dif: ambition 中性偏褒义指宏大抱负，也可指过度的权力野心。
words.pat: His ambition was to establish an international research institute.
words.patZh: 他的抱负是建立一个国际研究机构。

words.exam: 雄心勃勃的；野心勃勃的
c: ambitious plan 雄心勃勃的计划
words.dif: ambitious 描写计划宏大或个人极具进取心。
words.pat: The government launched an ambitious campaign to achieve carbon neutrality.
words.patZh: 政府启动了一项旨在实现碳中和的雄心勃勃的运动。

c: burst the bubble 打破泡沫
words.dif: bubble 指物理气体泡沫，或经济投机膨胀的虚幻泡沫。
words.pat: Financial analysts warned that the housing market bubble could collapse suddenly.
words.patZh: 金融分析师警告说，住房市场泡沫可能会突然破裂。

words.dif: budget 指划定的收支预算计划或控制支出的过程。
words.pat: The department managed to complete the infrastructure project well within budget.
words.patZh: 该部门成功地在预算之内完成了基础设施项目。

c: build a reputation 建立声誉
words.dif: build 可指修建实体建筑物，也可指建立抽象关系声誉。
words.pat: Engineers worked together to build a state-of-the-art research facility.
words.patZh: 工程师们合作建立了一座最先进的研究设施。

words.dif: business 指商业活动、企业或个人应管的私事。
words.pat: Adopting sustainable energy is essential for modern business success.
words.patZh: 采用可持续能源对于现代商业成功至关重要。

words.dif: compress 指施加压力使体积缩小，或压缩数据时间。
words.pat: Software algorithms can compress large video files without sacrificing clarity.
words.patZh: 软件算法可以在不牺牲清晰度的情况下压缩大型视频文件。

c: comprise several teams 包含几个团队
words.dif: comprise 主语可为整体表示包含部分，也可表示部分组成整体。
words.pat: The committee is comprised of distinguished representatives from diverse industries.
words.patZh: 该委员会由来自不同行业的高级代表组成。

c: reach a compromise 达成妥协
words.dif: compromise 既指双方各让一步妥协，也可指损害安全原则。
words.pat: Both parties were willing to reach a reasonable compromise to settle the dispute.
words.patZh: 双方都愿意达成合理的妥协来解决争议。

c: conceive an idea 构思创意
words.dif: conceive 侧重在脑海中孕育出新的构思、理念或方案。
words.pat: Architects managed to conceive a innovative plan for urban renewal.
words.patZh: 建筑师们成功地构想出了一项城市更新的创新方案。

words.dif: concentrate 强调将精神或力量资源汇聚集中于一点。
words.pat: Researchers need to concentrate on collecting reliable empirical evidence.
words.patZh: 研究人员需要集中精力收集可靠的经验证据。

words.dif: concept 指经过科学抽象概括出的理性概念法则。
words.pat: The teacher explained the fundamental concept of quantum physics clearly.
words.patZh: 老师清晰地解释了量子物理的基本概念。

c: conception of justice 对公正的理解
words.dif: conception 侧重指思维孕育形成新想法的过程或理解。
words.pat: The design underwent major changes from its original conception to production.
words.patZh: 该设计从最初的构想到投产经历了重大改变。

c: be concerned with 涉及/关心
words.dif: concern 指对人或事物的关心挂念，或与其有直接利害关系。
words.pat: Rising healthcare costs remain a major concern for middle-class families.
words.patZh: 不断上涨的医疗费用依然是中产阶级家庭的主要关切。

words.dif: concise 指语言文字简练明确、毫无废话废字。
words.pat: The executive requested a concise overview of the quarter's financial results.
words.patZh: 高管要求对本季度的财务结果作一份简明的概述。

words.dif: concrete 与 abstract（抽象的）相对，指具体存在的实物或明确的事实。
words.pat: Investigators must gather concrete proof before filing charges.
words.patZh: 调查人员在提出指控前必须收集具体的证据。

c: conclude a treaty 缔结条约
words.dif: conclude 侧重经推导推理得出结论，或使会议协议圆满结束。
words.pat: After examining the data, scientists concluded that the theory was sound.
words.patZh: 在检查数据后，科学家们得出结论认为该理论是可靠的。

c: draw a conclusion 得出结论
words.dif: conclusion 指思考推理得出的最终判断或文章末尾总结。
words.pat: The report reached the conclusion that immediate intervention was necessary.
words.patZh: 该报告得出了必须立即干预的结论。

c: concurrent events 同时发生的事件
words.dif: concurrent 强调多个事件在时间上完全同时发生或重合。
words.pat: The server can handle thousands of concurrent requests smoothly.
words.patZh: 该服务器可以平稳地处理数以千计的并发请求。

c: confer an honor on 授予荣誉
words.dif: confer 搭配 with 表示协商，搭配 on/upon 表示授予勋章学位。
words.pat: The committee will confer with experts before making a final decision.
words.patZh: 委员会在做出决定前将与专家商讨。

words.dif: conference 指正式、大规模的讨论或学术商务会议。
words.pat: Delegates gathered at the international conference to discuss climate policy.
words.patZh: 代表们聚集在国际会议上讨论气候政策。

c: confess to doing 供认做了…
confess one's sins 忏悔罪过
words.dif: confess 侧重承认错误、罪行或内心隐秘真实感受。
words.pat: The suspect eventually decided to confess to the crime during questioning.
words.patZh: 嫌疑人在审讯期间最终决定承认罪行。

words.dif: epic 指具有宏大历史、英雄主义色彩的叙事诗或壮丽事件。
words.pat: The film depicts the epic struggle of pioneers building a new nation.
words.patZh: 该电影描绘了开拓者建立新国家的史诗般挣扎。

fam: pandemic n. 全球大流行病
words.dif: epidemic 特指在某一地区广泛迅速传播的流行性疾病。
words.pat: Health agencies worked quickly to contain the sudden flu epidemic.
words.patZh: 卫生机构迅速行动以控制突发流感疫情。

words.dif: episode 指连续历史/事件中的独立插曲片段或电视剧集。
words.pat: This traumatic episode shaped his perspective on global public health.
words.patZh: 这一创伤性片段塑造了他对全球公共卫生的看法。

words.dif: epoch 侧重指由重大历史变革或新事件开创的新纪元时代。
words.pat: The invention of the steam engine marked the beginning of a industrial epoch.
words.patZh: 蒸汽机的发明标志着一个工业时代的开始。

words.exam: 冷漠的；不关心的；平庸的
words.dif: indifferent 指缺乏兴趣、同情心或关心，也可指质量一般。
words.pat: A civil society cannot afford to remain indifferent to extreme poverty.
words.patZh: 公民社会承担不起对极度贫困保持冷漠的后果。

c: feel indignant 感到义愤填膺
words.dif: indignant 特指因出于不公正、冒犯或不公平对待而产生的愤怒。
words.pat: Citizens grew indignant when unfair tax laws were introduced.
words.patZh: 当不公平的税法出台时，公民们变得义愤填膺。

words.dif: indignation 强调出于道德公义对邪恶非正义产生的义愤。
words.pat: The decision sparked widespread public indignation across the nation.
words.patZh: 这一决定在全国范围内引发了广泛的公众愤慨。

words.exam: 必不可少的；不可或缺的
c: indispensable part 不可或缺的部分
indispensable to 极宝贵/必不可少的
words.dif: indispensable 强调绝不可缺少、无法被替代或省去。
words.pat: Digital skills have become indispensable for professional career growth.
words.patZh: 数字技能已成为职业生涯增长不可或缺的部分。

words.exam: 个人；个体；个别的；独特的
words.dif: individual 与 collective（集体的）相对，指社会中的单一个人。
words.pat: The policy aims to respect individual rights while protecting public welfare.
words.patZh: 该政策旨在保障公共福利的同时尊重个人权利。

c: in a mess 处于混乱中
make a mess 搞得一塌糊涂
words.dif: mess 指物理上的杂乱无章，或局势陷入麻烦混乱。
words.pat: The new manager had to clean up the financial mess left by his predecessor.
words.patZh: 新经理不得不清理前任留下的财务混乱。

c: send a message 发送信息
words.dif: message 可指具体的书信口信，也可指演讲书刊的核心宗旨。
words.pat: The campaign succeeded in conveying its core environmental message effectively.
words.patZh: 该运动成功地有效地传达了其核心环境信息。

words.dif: messenger 特指负责传递口信、公文或包裹的专人。
words.pat: The urgent court order arrived via a special messenger late at night.
words.patZh: 紧急法院命令深夜由专差送到。

words.dif: method 侧重指有系统、有步骤、合乎逻辑的具体工作或研究方法。
words.pat: Adopting a rigid scientific method ensures accurate test results.
words.patZh: 采用严密的科学方法可以确保准确的测试结果。

words.exam: 好战的；激进的；激进分子
c: militant stance 强硬/激进立场
words.dif: militant 强调富有斗争性、手段强硬甚至具有武力倾向。
words.pat: The peaceful protest was infiltrated by a small militant group.
words.patZh: 和平抗议活动遭到了一个小型激进组织的渗透。

words.dif: military 专门与国防、军队武装力量相关。
words.pat: The country maintained strong military defense capabilities along its border.
words.patZh: 该国在沿边境保持着强大的军事防御能力。

c: change one's mind 改变主意
words.dif: mind 作名词指人的理智、头脑或主意；作动词指介意。
words.pat: Keep in mind that continuous learning is the key to personal growth.
words.patZh: 请牢记持续学习是个人成长的关键。

c: redeem a pledge 履行誓言
words.dif: redeem 指付代价换回物品，或通过良好表现弥补过失。
words.pat: The manager sought to redeem his reputation by leading a successful project.
words.patZh: 经理试图通过领导一个成功的项目来挽回自己的声誉。

words.dif: reduce 泛指使尺寸、数量、程度或价格降低变小。
words.pat: Companies are striving to reduce carbon emissions by using clean energy.
words.patZh: 公司正努力通过使用清洁能源来减少碳排放。

c: reduction in pollution 污染减少
words.dif: reduction 指数量、程度下降或削减的过程与结果。
words.pat: A significant reduction in operational expenses restored profitability.
words.patZh: 运营费用的显著减少恢复了盈利能力。

c: refer to 参照/参考/涉及
refer a case to 移交案件
words.dif: refer 搭配 to 可指提及、查阅资料或将问题移交决定。
words.pat: Please refer to the technical manual for detailed installation instructions.
words.patZh: 请参考技术手册获取详细的安装说明。

words.exam: 参考；查阅；推荐信；参考书目
c: for future reference 供日后参考
words.dif: reference 指查阅资料、推荐信，或文献中的参考引文。
words.pat: Keep this guidebook handy for quick reference during your business trip.
words.patZh: 请妥善保存此指南，以便在出差期间快速参考。
